name: Sushant Thapa

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sushant Thapa is a Nepalese poet and fiction writer from Biratnagar, with an MA in English literature from Jawaharlal Nehru University. His books include The Poetic Burden and Other Poems and Love’s Cradle. In a 2024 Kathmandu Post interview, he described a practice rooted in free verse, symbolism and philosophical reflection, and spoke of English as a way to tell Nepal’s stories.

“New Generation”, his poem in Kabita Live, begins with a makeup artist and a question about the difference between beauty’s instruments and a living face. Its short lines move from surface appearance towards creative inquiry. The ending celebrates experimentation and the learner’s capacity to surpass established knowledge, imagining new creation as a fountain.
